--- rough-ride hunt (copy this block unchanged) ---
rough-ride hunt | 4m05s | run 20261112-190030-hunt-bfab | 4 confirmed, 0 dropped on re-run
target: http://localhost:3790

Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. HIGH   Stats page shows results for an older date range when responses arrive out of order
   where: /stats (GET /api/stats/harvests)
   expected: After changing From to 2026-06-01 and then to 2026-08-01, the page shows stats from 1 Aug 2026
   saw: {"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","5 harvests from 1 Jun 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View","Courgette","NO. 2","Tomato","1.05 kg · Sungold","View","Tomato","NO. 3","Lettuce","350 g · Little Gem","View","Lettuce","Weight by plant and month","2.6 kg total","Harvest weight per plant and month, 1 Jun 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","PLANT\tJUN 2026\tJUL 2026\tAUG 2026\tSEPT 2026\tTOTAL","Courgette\t–\t1.2 kg\t–\t–\t1.2 kg","Lettuce · Little Gem\t200 g\t–\t–\t150 g\t350 g","Tomato · Sungold\t–\t450 g\t600 g\t–\t1.0…
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-190030-hunt-bfab/probes/faults.mjs (expectation "newest-response-wins")
2. MEDIUM Stats page crashes with an uncaught TypeError when the stats response is missing fields
   where: /stats
   expected: An error message, with no uncaught exception
   saw: {"pe":["Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-190030-hunt-bfab/probes/faults.mjs (expectation "empty-object-no-crash")
3. MEDIUM When loading fails, the stats page still shows the old range summary next to the error
   where: /stats
   expected: When the request for the new range fails, only the error shows, with no claim about the data
   saw: {"alerts":["5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Injected 500"],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Injected 500","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-190030-hunt-bfab/probes/faults.mjs (expectation "error-does-not-show-stale-range")
4. MEDIUM A stats request that never answers leaves 'Loading stats…' on screen forever over the old range's data
   where: /stats
   expected: The request times out with an error, or the page offers a retry
   saw: {"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-190030-hunt-bfab/probes/urls.mjs (expectation "hang-not-loading-forever")
--- end of rough-ride hunt ---
